[[File:Lets Play the Pokémon Card Game XY manga.png|thumb|right|Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!]]
(Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲーム{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}{{ruby|Ｙ|ワイ}}　やろうぜ～っ！}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Ryū Matsushima]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine, with a prologue in the January 2014 issue (released on November 21, 2013) and regular chapters from the February 2014 issue (released on December 21, 2013) to the December 2016 issue (released on October 21, 2016). Five original voice-over chapters, divided into four parts each, were released on the official Japanese Pokémon YouTube channel from July 17 to December 12, 2014. From [[CXY22]] onward, the manga was serialized as (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲーム{{ruby|Ｘ|エックス}}{{ruby|Ｙ|ワイ}}　{{ruby|ＢＲＥＡＫ|ブレイク}}　やろうぜ～っ！}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY BREAK!''). It is the sequel of [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!]] and is followed by [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc]]. It tells the story of [[Manabu Kadoo]]. The TCG format played in it for the first 2 chapters is {{TCG|Half Deck}}.
